objective: Bring the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer  to Deliana in Ironforge.

description: It's been great working with you, <name>.  Here is the finished product.
I hope it helps you in your current endeavors.  And hey, if you don't mind, help spread the word.  I wouldn't mind having more customers!
completion: Excellent! You've done well, <name>. I'm not sure I trust the goblin's craftsmanship, but I'm left with no other choice.
